provenance: New source translation; adjacent E4070-E4079 and E4160-E4169 reviewed.
context: Fiore's apparent kidnapping is a misunderstanding in one branch and real in another. Boots point toward her location. Cyrus searches for medicine to open a door out of town.
decisions: Preserve divergent quest branches, boot directions, and source's abrupt fragments. Herengracht provisional place spelling. Purple Medicine descriptive item term.

translations.en: said to you...
I was kidnapped?! By who?!
Someone kidnapped me? Well, with beauty like mine,
someone might want to make me their wife, even by force.
But I haven't been kidnapped, you know?
B-but I saw those big, nasty-looking grown men
taking you away with them, @7rFiore@0r!
Oh, those men. They did look like a bunch of thugs.
But they were chatting me up! They appreciated this lovely lady thief's skills
and asked, "Want to come adventuring with us?"
They weren't really my type, to be honest,
but they looked fairly capable, so I went along.
Then it turned out they were utterly useless!
The thug-faced fighter dropped dead straightaway,
and the rest of them ran off without a second thought!
Isn't that awful? You think so too, right? Right?
I think the monsters you just defeated
were the rest of the ones that attacked us. Thanks!
Well... it seems the kidnapping
had simply been @7rTanya's@0r misunderstanding.
Um... I'm sorry.
It looks like @7rTanya@0r definitely got the wrong idea.
You comforted @7rTanya@0r, saying you were glad nothing had happened.
Leaving @7rTanya@0r to listen to the muttered complaints
of @7rFiore@0r, you decided to return to town.
You returned to where the women's boots lay on the floor.
They were just as before, apparently untouched.
If this was a clue, what did it mean?
Being tall boots, had she considered which way they would fall?
The heels faced you,
while the toes pointed straight ahead.
The tops of the boots had fallen to the left.
Did that mean she went straight ahead? Or left?
Should you ignore them and go right?
Straight ahead, where the toes point
Left, where the boot tops point
Ignore them and go right
A pair of women's boots lay on the floor.
They were still warm, clearly worn by someone recently.
Those are @7rFiore's@0r boots!
She must be somewhere around here!
They were indeed warm, as if someone had just taken them off,
so she must be nearby. But where?
Could this be a clue?
But the tops of the boots had fallen to the left.
Apparently, this was the wrong way.
You sensed no one here, nor any sign of @7rFiore's@0r usual racket.
You should return to the previous spot and think again.
Somebody heeeeeelp me!
Argh, you little... Let me go!
You spotted what appeared to be humans carrying @7rFiore@0r.
Ahhh! You came to save me!
Th-these people are trying to sacrifice me!
Hurry! Heeeeeelp!
Thanks for saving me!
It'd be bad if their friends showed up while we're here,
so let's get back to the tavern first!
I'll explain everything properly once we're there!
Indeed, with no way of knowing how many allies they had,
there was no reason to linger here.
As @7rFiore@0r suggested, you should hurry back to the tavern.
A half-broken sign lay on the ground.
In faded, barely legible letters,
it read De Burcht.
You seemed to be close to your destination.
It should be around here.
Look carefully so we don't miss it.
You found a large box that appeared to be a medicine chest.
Ah, this must be it!
Just as @7rCyrus@0r was about to run over,
a monster appeared, blocking the way.
Inside the box was a vial filled with thick purple liquid.
You obtained a @3rPurple Potion@0r.
Is that all the materials we need?
According to what I was told,
if we perform the ritual at a place called Herengracht,
a door to the outside world will appear there.
A door lets us go back and forth,
so it's not reckless like punching a hole through, right?
I do think these things through, you know. Come on, let's go!
